appearance.intro: Choose how the app looks. The landing page always uses the default theme.
appearance.disableAutoplay: Disable autoplay on other users' profiles
appearance.disableAutoplayHint: When enabled, campaign songs on other users' profiles will not autoplay (only affects what you see)
appearance.classicUiHint: The redesigned navigation bar and the CEO Command Center dashboard are now the default. Turn this on to switch back to the classic navigation bar and corporation pages.
appearance.statusBarHint: Choose what's shown in the bottom status bar.

standard.label: Standard
standard.desc: Actions, campaign funds, personal cash, and corp treasury (when you are a CEO). Online count next to the turn timer.

corp.label: Corp Compact
corp.desc: Condensed online count; adds stock ticker, corp cash, and marketing strength when you run a corporation.

elections.label: Elections Compact
elections.desc: Political influence and favorability always shown. Adds vote share, margin, and seat projection when you're in an election.

full.label: Full
full.desc: Larger bar: profile stats plus elections and corporation panels together (corp only if you are a CEO).

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.desc: Turn timer and in-game date only. No stat chips, clean and distraction-free.

appearance.corpNote: Corp data only appears if your character is a CEO.
appearance.electionsNote: Vote share and seat projection only appear while you're an active candidate in an election.
appearance.fullNote: Corporation stats only appear if your character is a CEO. Election vote and seat chips only appear while you're an active candidate.
appearance.minimalNote: Just the essentials: in-game date, turn timer, and online player count.

security.introChange: Update your account password. Use a strong, unique password.
security.introSet: Set a password to enable username/email login alongside your social sign-in.
security.errorTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
security.errorSameAsCurrent: New password must be different from current password
security.setSuccess: Password set successfully! You can now log in with your username and password.

profile.intro: Display name and bio shown on your public profile.
profile.rules: Alphanumeric and spaces only. 3 to 30 chars. 24h cooldown.
profile.bioPlaceholder: A seasoned political operative from the heartland, known for...

identity.intro: Link your social accounts so other players can contact you.

apiKeys.intro: API keys allow external applications to interact with your account.
apiKeys.personalHint: Keys tied to your account. Public keys can only read public data. Private keys can also send campaign funds and trade forex on your behalf, so treat them like a password.

danger.resignDesc: Vacate your current office, all party leadership roles, congress leadership, and withdraw from any active elections.
danger.resignPrompt: Are you sure? This will immediately vacate all your held positions and withdraw you from all active elections.
danger.deleteDesc: This action is irreversible. Your account, character, and all data will be permanently deleted.
danger.modalWarning: This action is permanent and irreversible. Your account, character, and all data will be permanently deleted.

demographics.intro: Set your politician's demographic background. These traits influence how voter groups perceive you.
demographics.incomplete: Please select your character's background to complete your profile.

politics.intro: Shift your stance on economic and social issues. Costs 15 actions per shift.
politics.autoReelectionHint: When enabled, you will be automatically entered into new elections in your home district each cycle. You can still withdraw manually. Does not apply to presidential races.

campaignSong.intro: Set a YouTube video to play on your profile page. Paste a YouTube URL or video ID.
campaignSong.hint: Full YouTube URL or 11-character video ID. Leave blank to remove.
campaignSong.invalid: Not a valid YouTube URL or video ID.
campaignSong.autoplay: Enable autoplay on my profile (others can still disable this in their preferences)

referrals.intro: Share your invite link or code with friends. When they register and create a character, they start with a 10% stat bonus, +10 actions, and $500,000 personal capital. You'll receive +10 actions and $500,000 personal capital for each successful referral.
referrals.joined: {count, plural, one {player} other {players}} joined with your code
